value.answer: The lowest 5-year fixed I can find in Canada right now is 4.34% for an insured mortgage (under 20% down), as of today on Ratehub. With 20% or more down, the lowest is around 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging about 5.17%, and rates have been climbing again this month.
